title: Remove the duplicated admin allowlist from the application config family and guard the dead-config hazard
objective: AdminSection.allowed_users (apps/api/app/config/models.py) is validated by cli validate but never consulted: the enforced allowlist is settings.admin_allowlist, read in apps/api/app/admin/config.py and enforced in apps/api/app/admin/router.py. An operator editing or revoking via admin.allowed_users sees no effect and no error. This slice removes that one duplicated field and adds a durable AST guard that fails when a registered config family model is validated but never read by app code, with an explicit justified allowance for genuinely validation-only families.
in_scope: Remove allowed_users from AdminSection in apps/api/app/config/models.py.
Update the inline application YAML fixture in tests/unit/test_config_system.py to drop allowed_users.

Add tests/unit/test_config_models_are_consulted.py deriving family roots from FAMILY_MODELS via AST, detecting real reads via ast.Name loads outside apps/api/app/config/ and tests/, explicit allowance for ApplicationConfig and SchedulesConfig, anti-vacuous and precision unit tests.
out_of_scope: Wiring up the feature flags (FeaturesSection / CatalogueSection).
Touching settings.admin_allowlist, admin/config.py, or admin/router.py enforcement.
Removing AdminSection.authentication (single-valued Literal, benign declarative metadata, no hazard).
Editing ci.yml, feature_list.json, package-lock.json, scripts/check_urls.py, tests/unit/test_url_allowlist.py, .secrets.baseline.
acceptance_criteria: AdminSection no longer declares allowed_users; example YAML no longer contains it.
The application config example still validates.
New guard passes on the fixed tree; it FAILS naming the offender when a never-read family model is added.
Guard does not fire for a genuinely consulted model and treats a docstring-only mention as NOT consulted.
Guard asserts its derivation is non-empty and contains the four known family roots.
Full pytest suite passes; ruff check . and ruff format --check . pass.
Admin allowlist tests still pass; settings.admin_allowlist remains the enforced path.
